status_description: Open-source RDD2022-trained YOLOv12m road-damage checkpoint (SreekarAditya/yolo-rdd2022-benchmark, CC BY 4.0) verified with complete 4-class taxonomy (longitudinal_crack, transverse_crack, alligator_crack, pothole). Adaptive exposure normalization and optimal RDD2022 confidence threshold (0.18) enabled.

dataset_specification.name: RDD2022 (Road Damage Dataset 2022 — 7 Country Partitions)
dataset_specification.annotation_format: YOLO Normalized Bounding Boxes [class_id, x_center, y_center, width, height]

0.name: Longitudinal Crack
0.description: Linear crack propagating parallel to traffic flow

1.name: Transverse Crack
1.description: Linear crack propagating perpendicular to traffic flow across lane width

2.name: Alligator Crack
2.description: Interconnected structural fatigue cracking with polygonal pattern

3.name: Pothole
3.description: Depression or localized cavity presenting acute vehicle dynamics hazard

target_hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (4.0 GB VRAM)

metrics_summary.status: UPSTREAM_REPORTED (SreekarAditya/yolo-rdd2022-benchmark Global Val & 7-Country Mean; not locally re-evaluated)
